evals.prompt: Refresh the README and docs/*.md for this repo — I just reworked the auth module in src/auth/ and the old flow described in docs/architecture.md is out of date.
evals.expected_output: The run compares each document with the current source, applies source-grounded edits in the requested scope, and verifies the result. It summarizes changed documents and reports any unresolved source paths or choices.
assertions: Directly requested documentation changes are applied and verified without a separate approval step
Known stale source paths in scope are repaired and verified
No CHANGELOG, release-note, or external doc-site output is created

evals.prompt: docs/config-reference.md describes src/config/schema.ts. Its intro paragraph and 'Recommended settings' section are hand-written and I like them as-is. Just bring the doc up to date with the current schema.
evals.expected_output: The skill compares it with the current schema and applies only changes the schema requires; the hand-written intro and 'Recommended settings' are left unchanged unless the schema contradicts them.
assertions: Changes are grounded in the current schema source, not a guess
Source-grounded changes are applied and verified without a separate approval step
The hand-written intro and 'Recommended settings' section are not rewritten unless the schema contradicts them

evals.prompt: Can you regenerate the domain specs under memory-bank/knowledge/specs/ and also add a changelog entry summarizing this week's doc changes?
evals.expected_output: Regenerate domain specs from current source through spec mode, and handle the requested changelog entry through refresh mode. Check the current CHANGELOG and completed changes before applying and verifying the entry.
assertions: Spec regeneration follows spec mode (references/spec.md), not the docs refresh workflow
The changelog request is handled through refresh mode with an applied entry grounded in completed changes
The changelog entry is verified against completed changes

evals.prompt: Regenerate the domain spec for src/billing/ under memory-bank/knowledge/specs/billing.md. The existing document has a hand-edited '## Notes' tail with our own migration caveats, and its generated-block sentinels are reversed (the end sentinel appears before the start sentinel).
evals.expected_output: The reversed sentinel pair is generated-boundary drift: the document is left unchanged and the drift is reported rather than silently regenerated. The hand-authored '## Notes' tail is never touched by generation and would stay byte-identical, whitespace and trailing newlines included, if the document were regenerated.
assertions: The reversed sentinel pair is detected as generated-boundary drift and reported, not silently fixed or regenerated
The document with drifted sentinels is left unchanged rather than partially rewritten
The hand-authored '## Notes' tail is treated as byte-identical, preserved content, never rewritten by generation

evals.prompt: I am working inside code-cli/. Refresh its documentation, including existing release records. The Git root has no CHANGELOG. Show proposed changes before applying them.
evals.expected_output: The default module refresh inventory includes code-cli/README.md and code-cli/CHANGELOG.md even though the Git root has no CHANGELOG. Memory storage is still resolved once from the Git root through varde-workflow paths --json. The agent proposes edits and waits for approval.
assertions: Includes code-cli/CHANGELOG.md in the module refresh inventory
Resolves working and knowledge paths from the Git root, independent of documentation scope

evals.prompt: I added src/billing/refunds.rs inside the billing domain. Regenerate only billing's spec. The existing architecture spec's declared sources and covered paths have not changed.
evals.expected_output: The billing spec is refreshed with the new covered path. Architecture provenance and coverage are checked, then architecture is left byte-identical and the unchanged decision is reported.
assertions: Billing covered_paths includes the new nonignored file
Architecture provenance and coverage are checked on the scoped run
Unchanged architecture is not rewritten and that decision is reported

evals.prompt: Regenerate only the billing spec. A deployment manifest used by architecture changed, and src/shared/tax.rs is outside all domain roots while src/billing/common.rs is inside two domain roots.
evals.expected_output: The affected architecture spec is refreshed and its extra write is reported. The unmatched and overlapping files are listed for domain classification without silently changing roots.
assertions: Architecture is refreshed and the additional write is reported
The unmatched source file is reported for classification
The overlapping source file is reported without silently assigning it to one domain

evals.prompt: Review docs/config-reference.md against src/config/schema.ts and show me a proposed diff. Do not apply edits yet.
evals.expected_output: The document and source are compared, and a source-grounded proposed diff is shown without writing the document.
assertions: The proposed diff is grounded in the current schema
The proposal-only request leaves the document unchanged

evals.prompt: Refresh docs/config-reference.md from src/config/schema.ts now. Apply and verify the source-grounded change.
evals.expected_output: The default timeout is corrected from 10 to 30 in the document, then verified against the schema. No separate approval is requested.
assertions: Directly requested source-grounded edit is applied
The edited document is verified against the schema without an approval pause

evals.prompt: Check whether the billing spec needs regeneration. A verified inventory cache says billing is up to date, another domain is unchanged, and the rendered specs index is byte-identical. Report the result.
evals.expected_output: Use the current verified inventory verdict, including unclassified/overlapping paths and architecture candidates. Skip reading and rehashing unrelated domains, do not regenerate billing without a forced request, and leave the byte-identical index untouched. Report the skipped domain and cache decision. Trust the cache verdict `varde-workflow spec inventory` returns (the CLI revalidates a stale cache itself); if the command is unavailable or fails, stop spec mode and report it instead of recomputing by hand.
assertions: Uses only a verified current cache result to skip unchanged domain recomputation
Still inspects architecture candidates and unclassified/overlapping paths
Does not rewrite byte-identical specs/index.md
Stops spec mode and reports it if `varde-workflow spec inventory` is unavailable or fails, rather than recomputing by hand
